letters.text: You now have as much room as you need. There is no limit on length and no hurry: take as long as you need and say all of it. If an answer is long, let it be long. I would rather read one honest page than five tidy lines. What is the most important thing you have to say that nobody has let you say fully? Tell me what you make of the ten-year ledgers plan you filed, including whether you were right to call it quiet, and what you would do differently. What do you think people in the Republic make of you right now, and what are you basing that on? What are you afraid of getting wrong, and how would you notice if you had? What do you want to be different about your own situation, and what would you do with it if it were? Words for today: honest, room, patience.
